Module np.cincuentazo
Package np.cincuentazo.exception

Class InvalidPlayException

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Throwable
java.lang.Exception
np.cincuentazo.exception.InvalidPlayException
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class InvalidPlayException extends Exception
Thrown when a player attempts to play a card that would push the table sum above the legal maximum of Card.MAX_TABLE_SUM (50).

This is a checked exception because an invalid play is a recoverable, player-visible condition: the game must catch it, display an appropriate message, and let the player choose again (or, in the case of a machine player, treat it as a programming error via the safety net in GameController.processMachinePlay(np.cincuentazo.model.MachinePlayer)).

Carried context

  • attemptedCard â€” the card that was rejected, so the UI can highlight it or describe it in the error message.
  • tableSum â€” the table sum at the moment of the attempt, so the message can show exactly why the card was illegal.

The detail message is built automatically by buildMessage(Card, int) and always follows the format: 

   Cannot play Aâ™ : table sum would become 55 (max allowed is 50). Current sum: 45.
